verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud platform (not itself an agent), so shipping an official MCP server is a valid axis. Docs explicitly confirm two official MCP servers connecting AI tools/coding agents to Runpod, with authentication via API key or 'Sign in with Runpod' and coverage of Pods/endpoints/templates/registries, corroborated by a probe confirming the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of the MCP server working in practice, and deeper detail on setup/tool scope.
